intro: A UHF radio. Step 1 — NET: the screen shows a callsign; look up its frequency in the comms annex and have the Defuser dial it exactly (coarse ±1.00, fine ±0.25), then key XMIT. Keying on the wrong frequency is a strike. Step 2 — AUTH: the screen shows a phonetic challenge like WHISKEY · FOXTROT; find the row (first word) and column (second word) in the authentication matrix and have the Defuser spin the letter dial to that letter and press AUTH. A wrong letter is a strike.
